faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking

items.a: All our vehicles include: CDW insurance (Collision Damage Waiver), personal accident insurance, third-party liability, theft protection, and 24/7 roadside assistance. Zero-deductible coverage is not included — available for an additional $15/day.

items.q: What is the deductible in case of an accident?
items.a: The standard deductible is $800 USD in the event of an incident. To eliminate this deductible, we offer zero-deductible coverage for just $15 USD per day, available at the time of booking.

items.q: How does the security deposit work?
items.a: The security deposit is $400 USD for economy vehicles (Agya, Swift) and $500 USD for SUVs. Paid by credit card or bank transfer. Refunded within 5–15 business days once the vehicle is returned and inspected with no damages, fines, or outstanding charges. Sloth Rent a Car may deduct from the deposit: damages not covered by insurance, lost or damaged keys/accessories/documents, missing fuel, traffic fines, pending tolls, extraordinary cleaning for excessive dirt, and charges for late return.
More than 2 weeks in advance: 100% refund. Less than 2 weeks: 75% refund. Less than 1 week: no refund. A 50% deposit is required to confirm the booking.
We accept bank transfer, SINPE Móvil, cash in colones or dollars, and credit card. The security deposit must be paid by credit card or bank transfer.

Yes. We deliver and receive vehicles at Juan Santamaría International Airport (SJO) and at our Turrialba branch (Plaza Nuri, opposite the main IET entrance). Check availability and delivery rates via WhatsApp.
Yes. We offer child seats for $10 USD per day. You can add one at the time of booking.

about.label: About us
about.title: Our story
about.subtitle: Get to know who we are and why we do what we do
about.originTitle: How did Sloth Rent a Car start?
originParagraphs: We started with the goal of providing a more personal, transparent, and close-knit service — where every client feels supported from the moment of booking through vehicle return.
Today we continue to grow with the same mission: helping our clients explore Costa Rica with freedom, comfort, and confidence.
slothParagraphs: The sloth is one of Costa Rica's most beloved symbols. It represents the connection with nature, tranquility, and the unique way of savoring every moment that defines our country.

At Sloth Rent a Car we believe that traveling isn't about rushing from one place to another — it's about exploring at your own pace, discovering incredible landscapes, and creating unforgettable experiences.
Our name reflects that philosophy: drive freely, enjoy the journey, and live Costa Rica authentically.
Relax, take the keys, and explore Costa Rica your way.

faq.label: Information
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people ask us most about transfers

items.a: No, it's per trip, for up to 4 passengers.

items.q: Do you charge more at night or early morning?
items.a: No, the price is the same 24 hours a day.

items.q: What if my flight is delayed?
items.a: We track your flight details. If a delay means we wait longer, there's a $10 charge for each hour of waiting.

items.q: How much luggage can I bring?
items.a: Up to 2 large and 2 medium suitcases.

items.q: How far in advance should I book?
items.a: At least 7 hours ahead, so we can have everything ready.

items.q: Do you go to other destinations?
items.a: Yes. Choose "Other destination" in the form and we'll send you a quote on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I combine it with a car rental?
items.a: Yes. We bring you to Turrialba and you drive off in your car. Just check the option when you book the vehicle.
